article.headline: Magnitude 3.3 earthquake rattles Southern California coast near El Segundo
article.summary: A magnitude 3.3 earthquake struck off the coast of L.A. County's South Bay on Sunday at 9:17 p.m.
article.body:
Residents reported feeling a short but significant single jolt from Venice to Thousand Oaks as light fixtures rattled in Sawtelle. This tremor marks the fourth earthquake to hit the region in just four days, according to the U.S. Geological Survey. The event occurred at a depth of 6.2 miles and was rated a 3 on the Modified Mercalli Intensity Scale, indicating it was weak but noticeably felt by people indoors. No property damage or injuries have been reported following the incident.

For those in the region, these tremors serve as a reminder of California's active seismic landscape. The U.S. Geological Survey stated that the quake's epicenter was roughly two miles from El Segundo and three miles from Manhattan Beach. The activity follows other recent tremors, including a magnitude 3.9 quake in Commerce on Friday and a magnitude 3.3 quake near San Pedro on Saturday. A separate magnitude 3.2 earthquake also occurred early Monday morning off the coast of Newport Beach.

Geological data from the U.S. Geological Survey and UC Berkeley Seismological Laboratory indicates that the state remains under intense scrutiny regarding fault stress. In Northern California, a magnitude 3.0 earthquake was also recorded Sunday morning near the Mendocino Triple Junction, approximately 34 miles west of Petrolia. Researchers note that this complex area where tectonic plates converge frequently experiences seismic activity. Furthermore, a June study identified that tectonic stress along major sections of the San Andreas and San Jacinto faults has reached its highest levels in at least 1,000 years, keeping the region in a state of heightened seismic monitoring.

article.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo becomes Al-Nassr all-time top scorer in AFC Champions League Elite
article.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo broke his penalty curse with a 13th-minute strike against Al-Sadd to become Al-Nassr's record scorer in the AFC Champions League Elite.
article.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo reached a historic milestone at Al-Awwal Park by netting his 17th goal in the AFC Champions League Elite. This crucial penalty in the 13th minute officially moved him past Abderrazak Hamdallah, who held the previous club record with 16 goals in the competition. The successful strike also ended a recent spot-kick drought for the Portuguese star, who had missed consecutive penalties during his recent Saudi Pro League appearances.

The victory carries significant weight for Al-Nassr’s standing in the regional tournament as they push to improve their league stage position. With Al-Sadd struggling to secure a win in their four matches, the match served as a vital opportunity for the Saudi side to capitalize on their home-field advantage and solidify their campaign against a team currently sitting 15th in the standings with only two points.

According to Goal.com, the goal represents the 987th of Ronaldo's professional career, placing him only 13 goals away from the 1,000 mark. The match occurred during matchday five of the AFC Champions League Elite. Ronaldo’s contribution was essential, as he remains a central figure for the club following his arrival in January 2023. Sports Mole notes that while Al-Nassr sits seventh in the standings with six points from three matches, their domestic form also remains strong, keeping them within striking distance of the Saudi Pro League leaders.

As the tournament progresses, all eyes are on whether Al-Nassr can maintain this momentum toward the knockout stages. Following this fixture, the club continues its dual challenge of balancing domestic league duties with the rigorous demands of the Asian campaign.

news.og_title: غادة عادل وطارق لطفي يعلنان الحرب مبكرًا.. «حرب باردة» ينطلق لرمضان 2027! – شهريار النجوم
news.og_desc: بدأ العد التنازلي مبكرًا لموسم دراما رمضان 2027، وبدأت كواليس المنافسة تتحرك على أرض الواقع، بعدما أعلن المؤلف محمد سيد بشير انطلاق تصوير مسلسله الجديد «حرب باردة»، الذي يجمع كوكبة من النجوم في مقدمتهم غادة عادل وطارق لطفي وأحمد رزق، في عمل يراهن صناعه على جذب الأنظار مبكرًا، قبل أشهر من انطلاق السباق الرمضاني. وكشف محمد سيد بشير عن بدء التصوير من خلال مجموعة صور نشرها عبر حسابه الرسمي على موقع «إنستجرام»، وعلق عليها قائلًا: «من توكل على الله فهو حسبه ووكيله.. بداية تصوير مسلسل «حرب باردة»، إخراج أحمد جبة، وإنتاج أحمد الجنايني والمنتج رامي أحمد، وتأليفي.. رمضان 2027 بإذن الله». ويشهد المسلسل تغييرًا في اسمه، بعدما كان يحمل عنوان «نص نص الليل»، قبل الاستقرار على «حرب باردة»، وهو عنوان يفتح الباب أمام تساؤلات حول طبيعة الصراعات والأحداث التي سيقدمها العمل، خاصة مع اجتماع مجموعة من النجوم أصحاب التجارب المتنوعة في الدراما المصرية.
